_doc: Frozen capability tag vocabulary (Q-22, D-043). Agents' capability_tags and tasks' required_tags must come from this list. Adding a tag is a contract change: edit this file, AGENTS.md section 1a and DECISIONS.md in the same change.

tags.replan: Revise the graph on a trigger
tags.paper:extract: Extract a reproduction spec from a paper
tags.paper:search: Find candidate papers for a question
tags.baseline:search: Find published baselines for a dataset
tags.repo:infer-claim: Infer a claim from README or results
tags.code:adapt-data: Adapt code to a new dataset
tags.eval:stats: Judge statistics passed in from code
tags.lib:pykan: Knows the pykan API and its version drift (no seed agent; specialise target)
tags.bench:tabular-protocol: Fair tabular benchmarking protocol (no seed agent; fresh-spawn target)
